en: Hello! I'm Roxanne, the Leader of the Rustboro Gym. I teach at the Trainers' School, too.
I learned everything I know about battling from books and from my Rock-type Pokémon.
Let's see if your lessons were learned in the field. Show me what you can do!
So I lost... I see now that there's still so much I have to learn.
You've earned this. Please accept the Stone Badge, the official proof of your victory here.
{player} received the Stone Badge from Roxanne!
With the Stone Badge, your Pokémon can use Cut outside of battle, to clear small trees from your path.
And please take this TM as well. It's one I use myself.
TM39 holds Rock Tomb. It hurls boulders at the foe and slows it down, too.
There are other Gyms waiting for you. I hope you'll keep studying as you travel. I know I will!
Battles teach lessons that no textbook can. I'm grateful for ours, {player}.
Hey there, rookie! Roxanne uses Rock-type Pokémon. They're tough, but they can't take Water or Grass moves.
Rock moves hit Fire and Flying types hard, so think twice before you send those out!
Whoa, you beat Roxanne! You're a natural. The next Gym is a long way off, so take care out there!
